prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Exactly THREE equal-width tall portrait Mars habitat game backgrounds side-by-side in one landscape source sheet; each 390:844. Full-height paintings, clean divisions, no borders, gutters, text or labels. Input1 style/cream habitat architecture; input2 retro expedition equipment material. Photorealistic painterly cream metal and fabric, restrained teal shelter fittings, slight natural wear; not slick sci-fi or cartoon. All fixed furniture and story details confined to upper 38–42 percent, LOWER 58–62 percent a broad QUIET empty floor. At phone size the targets must be obvious physical equipment, inside center 82% of each panel. No people or movable game items.
LEFT PANEL: starter habitat service interior shortly after the puncture repair, before restoring main power. Curved cream insulated walls; small sealed window at upper center shows clear ochre Mars daylight. At x28%,y28%, a cream battery/reserve cabinet built into wall has a large empty teal-ringed CHARGING SOCKET and a dark charge lamp; fixed cabinet has vent grille, simple power conduit and protected recess, no loose cables. At x72%,y28%, EMPTY RADIO MOUNT: a small fixed shelf/backplate with mounting sockets and antenna bulkhead connector; no radio or antenna installed yet. Low glow from existing emergency heater and air circulation. A small square repaired wall patch appears near window edge. Do not paint portable solar arrays, bent antennas, atmospheric processor or duplicate carried equipment.
MIDDLE PANEL: SAME cabin, SAME camera, SAME reserve cabinet, SAME floor after the later dust storm arrives. Window now reveals dense opaque amber-brown dust, no clear horizon. Reserve cabinet has modest essential-power indicator, right radio shelf now carries the finished compact cream radio with speaker and one restrained amber receive light. The free wall between them is plain; NO second wall-mounted station service control panel—the player receives that as a movable compound diagram. Physical reserve and radio are existing installations, not newly fabricated. Keep broad quiet grey floor with warm brown light; no snow/ice indoors, damaged specimens or panic alarms.
RIGHT PANEL: adjacent clean FOOD PREPARATION corner of the same original starter habitat. Compact fixed stainless clean SINK at x50%,y29%, treated-water tap and a simple draining surface, modest cream cupboards, one sealed window with barren red landscape. A few plain stored-food sachets inside partly closed cupboard establish ordinary meal supplies; empty worktop otherwise. No fresh leaves, basket, bowls of completed meal, growing beds, loose utensils, specimen equipment or microscope. Lower floor quiet. Clear physical sink must fit within center 82%. Factory sink/cupboards belong to delivered cabin; no elaborate newly fabricated kitchen.
No words, numbers, symbols pretending to be readable labels, UI, people, floating items or ornamental machinery.
